summary: Stevens County, WA L-4 ground-house lookout begun 1933, used by the WWII Aircraft Warning Service, removed 1952; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 ground house on a concrete foundation, with a patrol point at Lookout Mountain one mile east
facts.status_note: Removed in 1952 per FFLOS and WillhiteWeb; Firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1950s
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service per FFLOS; Washington Division of Forestry per Firelookout.com

visit.drive_up: Dirt roads, passable for cars in dry conditions; the final turn is down a drainage
visit.trail_note: About half a mile one way up a ridge, 300 ft of gain, with brush at the start

events.note: Work started on an L-4 ground house on a concrete foundation (FFLOS, WillhiteWeb); Firelookout.com dates the L-4 cab to 1934
Newspaper notice, May 1934: Willis Ward of Orient had just finished the lookout house
Newspaper item places Fred Garringer on Lookout Mountain; WillhiteWeb says it is unclear which Lookout Mountain
Aircraft Warning Service activation; March 7 per WillhiteWeb, March 27 per Forest Lookouts
Lookouts reported a fire about 12 miles north on July 25; FFLOS and WillhiteWeb attribute it to a Japanese balloon bomb (single account, no second source found)
Wayne Francis named as lookout; last named in these sources
Registered December 11, 2010; nominated by Rod Fosback

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says built 1933; WillhiteWeb says construction started 1933; a May 1934 newspaper notice says the house was finished; Firelookout.com dates the L-4 cab to 1934. The story gives the 1933 start and the May 1934 finish, and sets FFLOS's 1933 build year against Firelookout.com's 1934 cab date.
WillhiteWeb gives March 7, 1942; Forest Lookouts gives March 27, 1942. Both give deactivation July 1, 1943. Both dates are recorded, unresolved.
FFLOS and WillhiteWeb say removed in 1952; Firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1950s. The dated sources are followed.

FFLOS lists the U.S. Forest Service; Firelookout.com credits the Washington Division of Forestry; Forest Lookouts lists a State Division of Forestry heading. Unresolved; the story says the sources differ.

notes_for_editor: The balloon-bomb attribution rests on the FFLOS and WillhiteWeb account (same text); a web search found no second source and the broader balloon-bomb histories were not read. Brief coordinates conflict (FFLOS 48.7997, -117.93895 vs west_us_lookouts 48.78741, -117.9486); not checked. Evelyn Johnson appears only on Firelookout.com. Brief agency field (USFS) follows FFLOS and is contested by Firelookout.com.
